newsitem.title: KENYA: 14 Kenyans killed in village raid - report.
newsitem.headline: 14 Kenyans killed in village raid - report.

text.p: Heavily armed attacker killed 14 people and beheaded some of the corpses in a raid on a village in Tana River District, a newspaper reported on Sunday.

The Sunday Nation quoted residents of Naninghi, 350 km (220 miles) east of Nairobi, as saying about 50 attackers killed 14 people and wounded a number of others in the raid on their village on Friday.
Local officials said 10 of the victims were shot and then beheaded, and the paper quoted a villager as saying the headless corpses were further mutilated by the attackers.
The officials said all the victims were members of the same clan, and there was speculation that the attack was related to an inter-clan feud.
Some families in have fled their homes in Nanighi village, the Sunday Nation said. Local officials told reporters on Sunday that police were combing the area to find the attackers.
